title: 🔥 Top AI Newsletters of 2024 on Substack
author: Michael Spencer
compiled_truth:
Hey Friends, 

This is a radical reading list if you are an AI enthusiast. I do not attempt to judge, rank or even categorize this list. I do however make some effort to be gender inclusive. 

However I think the Substack community has really blossomed in AI coverage in 2023 making it one of the more interesting stops for A.I. coverage, learning and exploration on the internet.  As well as news, research and speciality niche articles. 

I especially enjoy highlighting Newsletters you might not have heard of. These are writers with incredible expertise who share their work and passion often as a free service to the planet. 

Finally I have included a few polls in the list.

I am including links of these Newsletters that act as 2023 roundups if any, so be my guest to scroll down you might find something to read. 

Share

  

Leave a comment

If you’d like access to my own deep dives feel free to support the channel.

There are hundreds of AI rundowns on beehiiv, and barely any serious AI Newsletters on ConvertKit. The best place to start an AI Newsletter in 2024 are:
